front.title: Applicability of IETF-Defined Service and Network Data Models for Network Slice Service Management

abstract.t: This document describes how IETF-defined YANG data models can be used together to manage RFC 9543 Network Slice Services. It explains how a Network Slice Controller (NSC) translates a customer-facing Network Slice Service request into requests based on network models, such as the L3VPN and L2VPN Network Models, and how these relate to the corresponding service models. The document compares these models against Network Slice Service requirements, identifies gaps, and shows how the models apply in different controller architectures, including multi-domain deployments.
